text: とおくまで　みれるように　シッポを　つかってたつ。

structure.jp: とおくまで　みれるように
structure.en: so that it can see far into the distance

structure.jp: シッポを　つかってたつ。
structure.en: it stands up using its tail

patterns.name: 〜ように
patterns.explanation: ように after a verb means 'so that' that thing happens. とおくまで　みれるように = 'so that it can see far'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: みれる is the casual short form of みられる, which turns 'see' into 'can see'. みれる = 'can see'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one, and here it tells how the next one is done. シッポを　つかってたつ = 'stands using its tail'.
